facts.text: UConn Waterbury is federally designated as a Minority Serving Institution (MSI), both as a Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) and an Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander Serving Institution (AANAPISI).

sources.title: About UConn Waterbury | Waterbury
sources.quote: UConn Waterbury is proud to be federally designated as a Minority Serving Institution (MSI), both as a Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) and an Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander Serving Institution (AANAPISI).

facts.text: UConn Waterbury offers an Allied Health to Nursing academic track where students can earn two bachelor's degrees—a BS in Allied Health Sciences and a BS in Nursing—in as little as four-and-a-half years.

sources.title: Undergraduate Programs | Waterbury
sources.quote: This unique academic track offers you the opportunity to earn two bachelor's degrees – a Bachelor of Science in Allied Health Sciences and a Bachelor of Science in Nursing – in as little as four-and-a-half years.
